name: imprnt-plugin-session-host
description: imprnt module: a warm, user-started browser that holds your logged-in sessions and provides the authed-session capability. Deterministic code drives it; the human enrolls each site by hand.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --external playwright-core --outfile=session-host.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && bun build src/client.ts --target=node --outfile=client.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node'

author: Aleksandr Bogdanov
